glossary.def: Force Field: an effect on an enemy that deals DoT before it acts and charges the caster's Charge stacks. It makes the main target take DoT before its action; each time the enemy takes [Force Field] damage, the caster gains a Charge stack (scaled off ATK, capped at a few) and a little energy. It is the charging link of the Charge engine (Drive Knight in Silver form).
Stun: the target cannot act for a number of turns. A CONTROL effect, deals no damage. Many stuns are explicitly 'not affected by Hit' — bypassing both Hit and Effect Resist.
Injury: a debuff that makes the target take extra Injury DMG when it is attacked. Seeds delayed damage — the target takes Injury DMG whenever it is attacked.

Internal Injury: a delayed damage seed placed on a target that triggers WHEN the target attacks or is hit. It does no damage on application: it waits, then when the target is hit (or acts) it adds damage equal to a percentage of the caster's ATK, and disappears after triggering once. Several units can 'detonate' or absorb Internal Injury for extra burst.

Regeneration: while allies remain, before the next action the unit restores some HP and keeps fighting. Unlike Resurrection it can trigger repeatedly: while an ally is present, before the next action it heals about 10 to 75 percent HP and keeps fighting, up to a few times. Often paired with a bonus damage hit on trigger.

skills.body: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target, and deals an additional 10% of Max HP as bonus damage.

skills.label: Ultimate
skills.body: Deals 200% ATK DMG to a single target, and deals an additional 15% of Max HP as bonus damage.

skills.label: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.body: Deals 200% ATK DMG to a single target, with a 100% chance to deal an additional 15% of Max HP as bonus damage to the primary target, and a 50% chance to deal it to targets in the same column as the primary target.

skills.label: Passive
skills.body: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). After an ally in the same column attacks, immediately launches a [Follow-up] (attacks with 80% of Basic Attack's damage and effects).

skills.label: Extreme Passive
skills.body: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). After an ally in the same column attacks, immediately launches a [Follow-up] (attacks with 80% of Basic Attack's damage and effects).

skills.label: 5★ Passive
skills.body: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). After an ally in the same column attacks, immediately launches a [Follow-up] (attacks with 115% of Basic Attack's damage and effects).

glossary.def: Follow-up: an extra attack fired outside your turn when a condition is met (e.g. an ally attacks). Usually a repeat of a basic attack at some % of its damage and effects, capped to a number of triggers per turn.

skills.label: Cơ bản
skills.body: Gây 100% ST tấn công lên mục tiêu đơn.

skills.label: Tuyệt Kỹ
skills.body: Đánh mục tiêu đơn với 5 đòn liên kích gây 50% ST tấn công mỗi đòn, và cấp [Kiên Cường] cho bản thân và đồng minh cùng cột (hấp thụ ST bằng 30% Máu bản thân).

skills.label: Siêu Tuyệt Kỹ
skills.body: Đánh mục tiêu đơn với 5 đòn liên kích gây 56% ST tấn công mỗi đòn, và cấp [Kiên Cường] cho bản thân và đồng minh cùng cột (hấp thụ ST bằng 35% Máu bản thân).

skills.label: Bị động
skills.body: Vĩnh viễn tăng Máu bản thân. Khi bắt đầu trận đấu, cấp cho toàn bộ đồng minh 50% Tỉ lệ Khiên trong 2 lượt.

skills.label: Bị động cực hạn
skills.body: Vĩnh viễn tăng Máu bản thân. Khi bắt đầu trận đấu, cấp cho toàn bộ đồng minh 60% Tỉ lệ Khiên trong 2 lượt.

skills.label: Bị động 5 sao
skills.body: Vĩnh viễn tăng Máu bản thân. Khi bắt đầu trận đấu, cấp cho toàn bộ đồng minh 70% Tỉ lệ Khiên trong 2 lượt.

glossary.def: Resilience/Tenacity: chỉ bất kỳ khiên loại Kiên Cường — [Resilience] hoặc [Tenacity]; hiệu ứng áp/kiểm tra ở đây tính cả hai. Dùng khi một kỹ năng buff/kiểm tra khiên loại Kiên Cường mà không phân biệt [Resilience] hay [Tenacity].

skills.label: Basic
skills.body: Deals 100% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.label: Ultimate
skills.body: Strikes a single target with 5 combo strikes for 50% ATK DMG each, and grants [Tenacity] to self and allies in the same column (absorbs DMG equal to 30% of own HP).

skills.label: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.body: Strikes a single target with 5 combo strikes for 56% ATK DMG each, and grants [Tenacity] to self and allies in the same column (absorbs DMG equal to 35% of own HP).

skills.label: Passive
skills.body: Permanently increases own HP. At the start of battle, grants all allies 50% Shield Rate for 2 turns.

skills.label: Extreme Passive
skills.body: Permanently increases own HP. At the start of battle, grants all allies 60% Shield Rate for 2 turns.

skills.label: 5★ Passive
skills.body: Permanently increases own HP. At the start of battle, grants all allies 70% Shield Rate for 2 turns.

glossary.def: Tenacity: a shield layer that absorbs damage, usually scaled off Max HP. The shield is multiplied by Shield Rate and is eaten BEFORE real HP (Shield → Extra HP → Armor → HP). An enemy's 'Shield Break' deals extra damage to a Tenacity-holding target.
